Commercial Use and Attribution: Timestamps issued by FreeTSA may be used for commercial purposes'; '1. ... a maximum of one timestamping request per second per IP address'; best effort, no SLA. Root ca/freetsa.pem = https://freetsa.org/files/cacert.pem, file SHA-256 2151b61137ffa86bf664691ba67e7da0b19f98c758e3d228d5d8ebf27e044438 (published on freetsa.org/index_en.php; web.archive.org 2024 copy identical).
